title: GPT-5.2 proposes a formula for nonzero gluon amplitudes
summary: GPT-5.2 conjectured a formula for gluon scattering amplitudes with a single negative helicity in a special semi-collinear regime. An internal model produced a proof that the authors analytically verified; the announcement describes a preprint, not experimental confirmation.

evidence.tested: The arXiv abstract reports that the gluon formula satisfies several consistency conditions, including Weinberg's soft theorem, and that the formula is restricted to half-collinear configurations; no experimental test is described.
evidence.unknown: Not reported (the abstract states no limitations beyond the restricted half-collinear and complexified-momentum setting).
evidence.ai_role: GPT-5.2 conjectured the formula; an internal model produced a proof that the authors verified analytically.
